messages:
oliver: Hi all \/ quick Q: I had a vision exam yesterday (2026-07-10) but my benefits portal shows my HSA election change was processed effective 2026-08-01. Can I get reimbursed for the exam or change my HSA contribution retroactively? cc @lisa :eyes:
benefits-bot: Enrollment received. HSA election changes are effective the 1st of the month following a change request. Retroactive changes to pretax deductions are generally not permitted by carrier/IRS rules. Submit receipt to Expensify with category `healthcare-reimbursements` for a retro review. Guide: https://redwood.intranet/benefits/hsa-fsa :link:
lisa: Hi Oliver  welcome aboard. Short answers: 1) HSA elections can't be applied retroactively for prior payroll periods (IRS rules). 2) We can submit a carrier/benefits admin review to see if the vision claim can be processed under the plan based on service date and enrollment status. Please upload the itemized receipt and exam code (CPT/diagnosis if present).
oliver: Thanks  for Expensify, do I select pre-tax vs post-tax? Also I used an FSA last employer  does that affect anything?
payroll-bot: For Expensify: choose `healthcare-reimbursements`. Mark the amount as the full provider charge. We will determine taxability after benefits admin review. If you had an active HSA at previous employer, rolling funds into Redwood's HSA is separate; that doesn't change payroll elections. If you had an FSA previously, there's no carryover to HSA unless it's a limited-purpose FSA. If unsure, note your prior FSA in the Expensify memo.
marcos: Small tip: vision plans sometimes allow contacts/glasses claims even if medical HSA effective date is later, depending on vendor. Worth uploading the receipt and asking benefits to route to the vision carrier.
oliver: Uploaded Expensify ER-22111 and opened ticket #PO-4788. Attached itemized receipt and exam summary. I redacted full card numbers.
lisa: I see PO-4788  thanks. Copying the standard Expensify description people use:
```
Provider: Clearview Vision
Date of service: 2026-07-10
Service: Comprehensive eye exam + refraction
Amount: $78.00
Category: healthcare-reimbursements
Attachments: itemized receipt, exam summary
Notes: New-hire retro request; benefits election effective 2026-08-01. Please escalate to vision carrier for review. Redacted payment info.
```
benefits-bot: Ticket PO-4788 logged. Benefits admin will contact the vision carrier and respond within 3 business days. If carrier denies and you requested, People Ops can consider a discretionary reimbursement under our new-hire exception policy.
payroll-bot: If approved and processed as a benefits reimbursement, payment will be non-taxable and issued as a separate vendor transaction. If processed as a discretionary payroll advance, it will be taxable and recovered via future payroll unless otherwise specified.
oliver: Good to know  one last question: if I want to change my HSA to the family limit starting 8/1, when's the cutoff to request it to reflect on the 8/1 deduction?
lisa: Make the HSA change by the last calendar day of July in the benefits portal for an 8/1 effective date. After you submit, payroll will pro-rate contributions for August onward if you change mid-month. If you need help making the portal change, ping me and I can update it manually before the payroll cutoff.
oliver: Done  submitted the HSA change and noted `family` effective 2026-08-01. Thanks everyone! :pray:
marcos: Welcome again  and glad it was just an exam not a big procedure :sunglasses:
